rules.rationale: This rule defines the named ascending predicate by expanding it to list equality against the recursively defined ascending sort; it is a mathematical summary equation, not a separately established fact.
This rule defines duplicateBound as the existing at-most-two counting summary applied to the same input list in both roles; it is a direct named-predicate expansion.
This rule defines isSortedContract as the conjunction of the two previously named contract components, so it is a macro-style contract aggregation.
